# odlyzko31 certified tables (generated by tables.py from certified.json)

Every entry c is certified in Arb: rd_K = |d_K|^{1/n} > c for every number field K of degree n of the stated kind (kernel and constants in certified.json). "all": formal r1 = 0, valid for every signature (Odlyzko's convention). classical = zeros anywhere in 0 < Re s < 1 (our recomputation, same kernels); 31/32 = Cureton-Thorner strip (every K); B = Bebel half-plane for Dirichlet L (abelian K; equally every K under Liu's unrefereed B_2); Odl76 = Odlyzko 1976 Tables 2 (unconditional) and 1 (GRH), valid for degree >= n; elem = conductor count for abelian K.
